responsibility: Defines the common GCC target configuration for Fuchsia systems. It sets start/end files, forces PIE code generation by default through CC1_SPEC, provides the Fuchsia-specific library and linker specs with required -z and build-id/eh-frame-hdr defaults, identifies the libc model as musl for shared GCC logic, and defines the __fuchsia__ preprocessor builtin hook. This header captures Fuchsia’s OS-level compile and link policy rather than frontend or backend code.
